name: standing forward bend uttanasana
description: Fold forward from standing and let the head hang. It lengthens the hamstrings and back.
instructions: Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
